answer.answer: Sediment concentration (pieces/kg dry weight) and water column concentration (pieces/m3) are different units measuring different compartments, so they cannot be directly ranked as 'more polluted'. A valid comparison would require converting to a common unit/matrix or using site-specific contamination benchmarks for each medium separately.
